hooks.name: Welcome Message
hooks.description: Displays project information when starting a new session

action.prompt:
Welcome to the Personal Dashboard project! This is a vanilla JavaScript web application with:
- Light/Dark mode toggle
- Customizable Pomodoro timer
- Task management with sorting
- Quick links manager
- Beautiful animations

Remember:
- Only 1 CSS file in css/ directory
- Only 1 JS file in js/ directory
- Use vanilla JavaScript only (no frameworks)
- All data stored in LocalStorage

Project follows coding standards in .kiro/steering/coding-standards.md
